properties.Notes: Use map of China ca. 1911-1912. Source data is CHGIS county-level (1,986 features); dissolved into one national boundary via mapshaper -explode -simplify 8% keep-shapes -merge-layers -dissolve, then simplified (76,996 -> 7,136 vertices). 236 of 238 original polygon parts retained; 2 very small islets may have been lost during simplification.
properties.Source: CHGIS v6 (Harvard/Fudan), https://dataverse.harvard.edu/dataverse/chgis_v6 -- county-level 1911 layer, dissolved to national boundary
